verdict: Qualified as the photographic reconstructed work wagon of 1812 and 1835 at walking and street distance: its family matches both period pictures, it stands and rolls on the rendered ground within its limits, it clears every tree along both 1812 routes and at both covered-wagon stands, and its levels hold the phone and desktop costs below. It is a modern licensed construction reference painted and placed by the project, not an attested 1835 Chicago specimen.

references.subject: lower-right covered work wagon, rear quarter
agrees: upright plank-sided box on a reach and bolsters
blue box with red-brown running gear (the Western Hotel covered wagon's coat)
pale canvas cover over the box
differs: Wild's cover is lower and loosely draped; the covered wagons keep v1's five bows
the painting gives no scale, spoke count, joinery or wood

references.catalogue: chicago/reference/images/IMAGE_SOURCES.md (The Picture Book of Earlier Buffalo, 1912, p. 163; no data/sources record)
references.subject: open four-wheel box wagon loaded with barrels (left of centre), side view; ox-drawn rack wagon with bare bows (right)
agrees: open plank box on four spoked wheels
box sides at about the rear wheels' height
plank rack sides like the master's boards
differs: the halftone resolves no joinery, kingbolt, reach or spoke count

matched_views.camera: three.js perspective, fov 30, chosen by eye to the reference's quarter; a painting gives no solvable camera

ground.scope: all roll phases and every steer angle within the declared limit

trees.method: each tree trunk the walk scene reports (api.standOccluders: parkway trees, posts and grown timber trunks, with radii) against the vehicle's envelope at every 0.5 m of its route, or at its stand
trees.envelope: driven: the row's measured envelope_local_xz_m; parked: wheels ±0.8 m by ±1.8 m and a 0.12 m pole to 4.4 m ahead

clearance.buildings: driven rows: the runtime swept-envelope clearance against building footprints (transport-clearance.js) refuses any step that touches one; parked: the stands are the original yard stands, qualified by tools/transport/check_parked_placements.py

lod_use.desktop: near (parked within 100 m at Full, 65 m Balanced; driven teams)

cost.shared: the farm-box GLB is decoded and uploaded once per layer however many parked models stand on it (parked-transport.js caches by file)

in_scene_frames.note: whole-frame renderer stats at the same pose and view, before (v1) and after (v2); frames also hold moving people, so small differences are not all the wagon's

cost.phone_memory: Not at spawn: the parked layer loads within 50 m on phones. Beside one covered wagon a phone now holds about 14 MiB of its textures (mid 8 + cover 6) where v1 held 8; both wagons stand 250 m apart, so one is near at a time. The 1835 mobile resident ceiling (tools/memory_ceilings.json) is read at spawn and is not moved by this change; it was not re-measured in this container.

limits: Matched views are qualitative quarter/side comparisons with paintings and a halftone, not solved cameras. No suspension, force or collision certification beyond the bounds above. The licence, credit and adaptation notice stay as recorded in assets/LICENSES.md (L-farm-box-licensed-master-2793; this qualification: L-wagons-brougham-3558).
